title: trifolium xanthinoides
intro: Trifolium xanthinoides, commonly known as yellow clover, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family, native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The health benefits of Trifolium xanthinoides include its potential in reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antibacterial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Trifolium xanthinoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
